mapper.sql: SELECT ap_id, company_id, ap_no, source_module, source_type, source_id, source_key, partner_id, partner_name, supplier_id, ap_date, period, amount_excl_tax, tax_amount, total_amount, paid_amount, tax_rate, invoice_no, invoice_code, invoice_date, due_date, payment_days, status, dept_id, user_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM fin_ap_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin_ap_order ( ap_no, source_module, source_type, source_id, source_key, partner_id, partner_name, supplier_id, ap_date, period, amount_excl_tax, tax_amount, total_amount, paid_amount, tax_rate, invoice_no, invoice_code, invoice_date, due_date, payment_days, status, dept_id, user_id, create_by, create_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{apNo}, #{sourceModule}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{sourceKey}, #{partnerId}, #{partnerName}, #{supplierId}, #{apDate}, #{period}, #{amountExclTax}, #{taxAmount}, #{totalAmount}, #{paidAmount}, #{taxRate}, #{invoiceNo}, #{invoiceCode}, #{invoiceDate}, #{dueDate}, #{paymentDays}, #{status}, #{deptId}, #{userId}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.update: UPDATE fin_ap_order SET paid_amount = #{paidAmount}, status = CASE WHEN #{paidAmount} <= 0 THEN 'OPEN' WHEN #{paidAmount} >= total_amount THEN 'SETTLED' ELSE 'PARTIAL' END, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() WHERE ap_id = #{apId} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: WHERE ap_id = #{apId} AND del_flag = '0' FOR UPDATE

SELECT CASE WHEN a.status IN ('SETTLED','VOID') OR a.total_amount - a.paid_amount <= 0 THEN '已核销' WHEN DATEDIFF(#{today}, a.due_date) <= 0 THEN '未到期' WHEN DATEDIFF(#{today}, a.due_date) <= 30 THEN '逾期1-30天' WHEN DATEDIFF(#{today}, a.due_date) <= 60 THEN '逾期31-60天' WHEN DATEDIFF(#{today}, a.due_date) <= 90 THEN '逾期61-90天' ELSE '逾期90天以上' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(a.total_amount) AS totalAmount, SUM(a.total_amount - a.paid_amount) AS unpaidAmount FROM fin_ap_order a WHERE a.del_flag = '0' AND a.status NOT IN ('VOID') GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY FIELD(bucket, '未到期', '逾期1-30天', '逾期31-60天', '逾期61-90天', '逾期90天以上', '已核销')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS apCount, SUM(total_amount) AS totalAmount, SUM(paid_amount) AS paidAmount, SUM(total_amount - paid_amount) AS unpaidAmount FROM fin_ap_order WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status != 'VOID'
AND period = #{period}

SELECT a.ap_id, a.company_id, a.ap_no, a.source_module, a.source_type, a.source_id, a.source_key, a.partner_id, a.partner_name, a.supplier_id, a.ap_date, a.period, a.amount_excl_tax, a.tax_amount, a.total_amount, a.paid_amount, a.tax_rate, a.invoice_no, a.invoice_code, a.invoice_date, a.due_date, a.payment_days, a.status, a.dept_id, a.user_id, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.remark FROM fin_ap_order a WHERE a.del_flag = '0' AND a.status IN ('OPEN', 'PARTIAL') AND a.due_date IS NOT NULL AND a.due_date < #{today} AND a.total_amount - a.paid_amount > 0 ORDER BY a.due_date LIMIT #{limit}
